vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek had the day of their life — 1478 kcal. Two days of food from one person.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek came back with 512 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇮🇳 Hindi. You share no language at all.
🛡️ Michelle, Daniyar, Ursula and the woman in her 30s, with weathered hands met them at the door — 4 put down. Michelle, Daniyar, Ursula, the woman in her 30s, with weathered hands are hurt.
🛡️ Michelle, Kevin, Daniyar and Tashi met them at the door — 4 put down. Michelle, Daniyar, Tashi are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Leo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

regDeaths.name: a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a crow that watches too long and blinks too little
